import json, urllib.request, ssl

token = open('/tmp/owner_token.txt').read().strip()
files = json.load(open('/tmp/push_batch_missing.json'))

payload = {
    "action": "github_commit_multi_file",
    "input": {
        "branch": "main",
        "commitMessage": "fix: push 11 missing ios-ivx-knowledge-base source files",
        "confirm": True,
        "confirmText": "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE",
        "files": files
    }
}

print(f"BODY_SIZE={len(body)} bytes")

req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action",
    data=body,
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    },
    method="POST"
)

ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=30) as resp:

        print(f"FILES_PUSHED={r.get('filesCommitted', r.get('filesPushed', len(files)))}")
        print(f"RESPONSE_KEYS={list(r.keys())}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"STATUS=ERR")
    print(f"ERROR={e}")
    try:
        print(f"BODY={e.read().decode()[:500]}")
    except:
